statements.text: Panprotopsychism holds that fundamental physical entities have protophenomenal properties: not themselves forms of consciousness, not the structural properties physics reveals, but able in combination to ground conscious subjects. Panqualityism, which takes them to be unexperienced qualities, is its clearest form.

sources.quote: Panprotopsychism is the thesis that fundamental physical entities have protophenomenal properties.
whereas panpsychists believe that basic matter has consciousness, panprotopsychists believe that basic matter is protoconscious
